```{ojs}
//| label: fig-lotp-voronoi
//| fig-cap: Law of Total Probability visualised. An event $A$ (orange) overlaps a partition $B_1,\ldots,B_{k}$ of $\Omega$. The shaded pieces $A\cap B_i$ decompose $\operatorname{Pr}(A)$ as $\operatorname{Pr}(A)= \sum_i \operatorname{Pr}(A \cap B_i)$.
//| fig-align: center
{
  const width = 720, height = 360;
  const pad = 20;

  // Soft region fills share the same identities as the figure series palette.
  const fills = [
    "var(--plot-fill-1)",
    "var(--plot-fill-3)",
    "var(--plot-fill-5)",
    "var(--plot-fill-4)"
  ];
  const col = i => fills[i % fills.length];
  const orangeStroke = "var(--plot-series-2)";
  const orangeFill = "var(--plot-fill-2)";

  // deterministic RNG
  const rng = d3.randomLcg(2);

  // Voronoi sites
  const sites = d3.range(n2).map(i => ({
    name: `B${i+1}`,
    x: pad + rng() * (width - 2*pad),
    y: pad + rng() * (height - 2*pad)
  }));

  const delaunay = d3.Delaunay.from(sites, d => d.x, d => d.y);
  const vor = delaunay.voronoi([pad, pad, width - pad, height - pad]);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .style("background", "var(--plot-bg)")
    .style("color", "var(--plot-fg)")
    .style("font-family", bodyFont)
    .style("font-size", "14px");

  // --- defs: rounded-rect clip for Ω + per-cell clipPaths + ellipse for A ---
  const defs = svg.append("defs");

  defs.append("clipPath")
    .attr("id", "clipOmega-lotp2")
    .append("rect")
      .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
      .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
      .attr("rx", 10);

  // Per-cell clipPaths (so we can draw A∩B_i by clipping the ellipse to each cell)
  for (let i = 0; i < sites.length; i++) {
    const poly = vor.cellPolygon(i);
    if (!poly) continue;
    defs.append("clipPath")
      .attr("id", `clipCell-lotp2-${i}`)
      .append("path")
      .attr("d", d3.line()(poly));
  }

  // A: ellipse geometry
  const Ax = width * 0.50, Ay = height * 0.52;  // centre
  const Arx = width * 0.42, Ary = height * 0.4;

  // --- Voronoi cell fills: the back layer of the diagram ---
  const cellFills = svg.append("g").attr("clip-path", "url(#clipOmega-lotp2)");
  const polys = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sites.length; i++) {
    const poly = vor.cellPolygon(i);
    if (!poly) continue;
    polys.push({ i, poly, name: sites[i].name });
    cellFills.append("path")
      .attr("d", d3.line()(poly))
      .attr("fill", col(i));
  }

  // --- A∩B_i pieces (orange), revealed up to 'frame2' ---
  const overlaps = svg.append("g").attr("clip-path", "url(#clipOmega-lotp2)");
  for (let i = 0; i < sites.length; i++) {
    overlaps.append("ellipse")
      .attr("cx", Ax).attr("cy", Ay)
      .attr("rx", Arx).attr("ry", Ary)
      .attr("fill", orangeFill)
      .attr("fill-opacity", i < frame2 ? 1. : 0)  // reveal progressively
      .attr("clip-path", `url(#clipCell-lotp2-${i})`);
  }

  // Redraw the partition boundaries after the animated fills so they stay clear.
  svg.append("g")
    .attr("clip-path", "url(#clipOmega-lotp2)")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(polys)
    .join("path")
      .attr("d", d => d3.line()(d.poly))
      .attr("fill", "none")
      .attr("stroke", "currentColor")
      .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.62)
      .attr("stroke-width", 1.25);

  // A must be the top geometric layer: its outline remains visible throughout.
  svg.append("ellipse")
    .attr("cx", Ax).attr("cy", Ay)
    .attr("rx", Arx).attr("ry", Ary)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", orangeStroke)
    .attr("stroke-width", 4)
    .attr("vector-effect", "non-scaling-stroke")
    .attr("clip-path", "url(#clipOmega-lotp2)");

  // Labels at polygon centroids are also kept above the animated pieces.
  const fz2 = Math.max(10, Math.min(14, 16 - 0.3 * (n2 - 3)));
  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(polys.map(d => {
      const [cx, cy] = d3.polygonCentroid(d.poly);
      return { x: cx, y: cy, name: d.name };
    }))
    .join("text")
      .attr("x", d => d.x)
      .attr("y", d => d.y)
      .text(d => d.name)
      .attr("font-weight", 700)
      .attr("fill", "var(--plot-muted)")
      .attr("font-size", `${fz2}px`)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .attr("dominant-baseline", "middle");


  // Ω frame
  svg.append("rect")
    .attr("x", pad).attr("y", pad)
    .attr("width", width - 2*pad).attr("height", height - 2*pad)
    .attr("rx", 10)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", "currentColor")
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.55);

  // Ω label
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", pad + 8).attr("y", pad + 16)
    .text("Ω")
    .style("font-weight", 400)
    .style("font-size", "18px")
    .attr("fill", "currentColor");

  // A label
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", Ax).attr("y", Ay)
    .text("A")
    .attr("fill", "currentColor")
    .attr("font-size", 18)
    .attr("font-weight", 700)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle");

  return svg.node();
}

```

```{ojs}
// Animation driver: each button click restarts the reveal
frame2 = {
  if (!click2) return 0;
  const delay = 600;
  let i = 0;
  while (i <= n2) {
    yield i;
    await Promises.delay(delay);
    i++;
  }
  return i;
}

```

```{ojs}
// Compact controls BELOW the plot (two inputs): k and Play animation

// Two controls: k (slider) and Play animation (button)
viewof controls2 = {
  const leftForm  = Inputs.form(
    { n: Inputs.range([3, 50], { value: 10, step: 1, label: md`${tex`k`}: number of sets` }) },
    { submit:false }
  );

  const playBtn = Inputs.button("▶ Play");
  playBtn.classList.add("btn-resim");  // reuse your teal button style

  const rightForm = Inputs.form({ click2: playBtn }, { submit:false });

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Law of Total Probability controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Partition size</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Animation</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const grid = root.querySelector(".controls-grid");
  grid.children[0].append(leftForm);
  grid.children[1].append(rightForm);

  const getValue = () => ({ ...leftForm.value, ...rightForm.value });
  const update = () => { root.value = getValue(); root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles:true })); };
  grid.addEventListener("input", update);
  queueMicrotask(update);
  return root;
}

// reactive
n2     = controls2.n
click2 = controls2.click2
```
